notes.title: Newest Team Ladybug Title: New Blade Chimera Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear Team Ladybug and Metroidvania fans,

There's only a month left until the release of Blade Chimera, Team Ladybug's very first original Metroidvania, on January 16, 2025!

In response to feedback from Team Ladybug fans, Blade Chimera has a larger map and more side quests than any previous title, making it an even deeper and longlasting experience for players.

We've released a new and updated demo for Blade Chimera, so please check it out to get a feel for the game yourself!
Back in June, we made a demo for Steam Next Fest, and in the past half year that demo has been further improved and expanded on to make this new demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/83f454527ba0ef8b530cf4cad2d914fb511c9e4a.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Stage 2: Phoenix Gardens is now playable
[*]Added a new ability to Lux, the Demon Sword: When you’re separated from the Demon Sword, power is charged in the blade. When it returns to you, it creates a shockwave that deals damage along its path
[*]Added a new collectable item: Puzzle Pieces
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/5ffe19da9deaa099fe23d4c51b3162a9a4f93bd2.gif[/img]

We hope you like the new demo! 
Please wishlist the game and look forward to launch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33228726/c68c4aac178c96060a8d9ab74ccd83736313eec6.gif[/img]

notes.title: VR Rhythm Game SoundArt released!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/098486e02d1e5d334133ab871585beec0882c8f0.jpg[/img]

Dear Fans,

Mercury Studio, a one man studio which created the popular battle racing games Break Arts and Break Arts II is back with SoundArt, a brand new title!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/804e2609c6524af14d3260fbfb77aa27f5724a36.png[/img]

[h3][b]Exhilirating Rhythm Action[/b][/h3]
Hit, sweep and thrust the blocks that come flying towards you in time with the music.
Maneuver your sticks gracefully and rack up points!

[h3][b]Unlimited Stages[/b][/h3]
Load your own tracks into the game and watch as your favourite tunes become new levels.
Rock and Pop tunes will provide particularly challenging stages! The number of stages si only limited by the size of your music library!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/1a514cf69e837759a7d3f149d11ae883e189cdea.png[/img]

[h3][b]Show me, Show you.[/b][/h3]
Sound Art has a Live Show mode where you can stream and show off your playstyle to a crowd.
With VRM avatar support, with a simple file swap you can play as your favourite avatar.
Also if you're streaming on youtube or twitch, viewer reactions will appear in game so you can connect with your audience!
SoundArt isn't just a game for the one with the VR headset on, it's also for the viewers.

[h3][b]Indie Game Collab Tunes Included![/b][/h3]
Tracks from upcoming crustacean battle game Fight Crab by Nussoft and Touhou Luna Nights have been preloaded!

What kind of levels will these tracks become?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1213750/Fight_Crab/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36254969/2b6192f189b44110f64fa40a68b084517b3b5c35.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy SoundArt, where your performances and music join to become a unique piece of Art.

notes.title: 100K Downloads! Thank You for Your Support! “Dash” Fixes & German Support Incl. in Update!
notes.content:
Dear players,
 
Touhou Luna Nights, which saw its final update roll out on June 15th, has officially topped 100,000 downloads!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cf141467679ffe57a92fb74a8cbc8e23c14594ac.gif[/img]
 
It’s thanks to the invaluable support and reviews of players like you that we were able to pass this significant milestone less than four months after the Ver. 1.0 release on February 26th. 
Thank you all so much!
 
Below we’ve got a comment received from the developers at Team Ladybug!
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/afba758722711029623f4b8e40e44b50738e63f9.jpg[/img]
 
[i]To be honest, we are truly surprised by all the support we’ve received from so many players out there. We are extremely happy to see how much players like the graphics and game systems we’ve worked so hard to create. From here on out, we will continue to strive to create games enjoyable by both children and adults alike, and we greatly appreciate your invaluable and ongoing support.
-Team Ladybug[/i]
 
Also, we’ve implemented [b]fixes for the “Dash”[/b] feature that everyone requested.
 
1) Dash now ends when the lever is in neutral
2) Dash now ends and the character dodges backward when attacking and pushing the lever left or right during Dash
 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/015243e64a091ff41527729fd9fa99291aec23cb.gif[/img]
 
Finally, we’ve also implemented the German language support we promised earlier.
 
There’s a brand new mode available after clearing Boss Rush, so keep playing Touhou Luna Nights and see if you can make it all the way through!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/cc548ee0b2abc1bd8d0f9dfd7a2d011d245eb2ae.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/851100/Touhou_Luna_Nights/

The long-awaited, much-requested screenshot feature will be included with the update.

[h1]■Large improvements in operational speed[/h1]

・We've received complaints from several users that the game wasn't working in 60fps, so with this update comes some huge improvements in operational speed.

If game speed drops below 60fps, please try changing the refresh rate to 60 in Windows display settings.
*With some monitors such as certain 4K displays, you may be unable to set the refresh rate at 60. In this case, you may need to reduce resolution to 1920*1080.

If you are still unable to fix the problem, please contact us via the bug report 

Additional language support is also currently being considered, and German is scheduled to be added in the near future.

A year after entering Early Access, after all sorts of tweaks and improvements we are finally able to release this ultimate update thanks to all the support we've received from our fans.
Thank you all so much.

We hope you all enjoy the game, and please keep supporting Team LadyBug and Touhou Luna Nights!

notes.title: The final update is currently under development! We will release a few new elements!
notes.content:
ladies and gentlemen

notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today we’ve updated Touhou Luna Nights to Ver. 1.0!

With this latest update comes the addition of Stages 4 and 5, as well as new weapons and gimmicks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/ad38f6aaac79e6a7b2a8b824859474dc1a244a19.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/1791def41c7e6c7171fafb9e032f4e77cf6a3ffd.gif[/img]

■Screw Knife
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/92cbb23040c79f777dac387e8aac82affd272469.gif[/img]


■Yellow Aura
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/998406d723831a1ff19632220decd2ae66cf202d.gif[/img]


Also appearing as boss characters are “Remilia”, who swept Sakuya into this strange world, and her sister, “Flan”!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/dcf481c6edd116112bda48a4bf8a180e568e2eca.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/6273e7cf103ab31ed7ac54d91f08d9c3df97cda4.gif[/img]

Are you ready for the life-and-death battle that awaits?!

[h1][To everyone who plays from Ver 1.0][/h1]

For those of you who are picking up the game for the first time, here’s a quick introduction as to what sort of awesome title Touhou Luna Nights is.

This game was built in such a way as to fully take advantage of the beautifully rendered sprite animation, the Touhou Project’s “grazing” system which allows for the recovery of HP and MP, and main character Sakuya Izayoi’s power of controlling time and hardcore knife battles.
It also boasts extremely high levels of Metroidvania-style action as you are forced to overcome a wide variety of gimmicks while also taking time to explore the vast map.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/24f5d34423c0e640d35a25c41cc0cfd5c767293e.gif[/img]

After Ver. 1.0, we plan to continue updating the game, with additions such as achievements, Boss Rush, and extra stages in which a certain special someone for whom players have been waiting makes an appearance.

We hope you enjoy the world of Touhou Luna Nights!

[h1][Ver. 1.0 Commemorative Sale on All Vaka Titles & Touhou Project/Metroidvania Bundle][/h1]

notes.title: Stages 2 & 3 Update Details
notes.content:
Hello, players!

Today, we’ve released a large update, adding Stages 2 and 3.

Having defeated the boss of Stage 1, Sakuya heads off to meet an important figure in order to unravel the mystery behind this mysterious world.
But along the way appears a certain witch...
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/8e0297db5ae4e4d822e3e93c1f6bbc0a60f6ef67.gif[/img]

Who created this strange world in which Sakuya finds herself after overcoming the dangers of her last battle?


This update includes the following features, as requested by a large number of players:

・High attacks

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/c0f54f80d0206e3bf58567314b03d87bea254076.gif[/img]

・Button assignment for Confirm/Cancel and Attack/Jump
・Button assignment for skill toggling

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/31dc2e27a33b44de4af37e826292c12a4fda02ff.png[/img]




Further additions and adjustments include:

・Double-jump

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/dd914322e6ff02a72953926a6e61b1933368e8c5.gif[/img]

・Movement via knife

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/308e288dbf2d6563d20fde152ab228b4df7a6926.gif[/img]

・Newly added weapons

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/d23f6b19236e272b7c60bf24d4afc78e56de142f.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/24f5d34423c0e640d35a25c41cc0cfd5c767293e.gif[/img]

・Nitori’s Shop has been made remotely accessible

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/463b386e9114a48b4ce85feec673ecc7a716ebd8.gif[/img]

・New gimmicks utilizing the time-stopping ability

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33228726/8a419f08353e83a50afaecfbea87c4e91be0d99f.gif[/img]

...and many more.


Since there was such great demand for a Hard Mode, the difficulty level for Stages 2 and 3 has been increased significantly.
 
We hope you enjoy this latest journey into the world of Touhou Luna Nights!
